title: Vampire Vape Black Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Black Ice by Vampire Vape is a true sweet shop classic. If you remember the sweet, spicy and subtly minty sensation of Blackjacks then you’ll simply love this E-Liquid . Sugary-sweet with a gentle liquorice kick, the wave of cool menthol that meets you on the exhale pulls this delicious Black Ice Vampire Vape e-juice together in a way that you won’t be able to get enough. Upgrade your vape collection with thi s Vampire Vape Black Ice 10ml E-Liquid , you won’t be disappointed. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please Note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits.
